scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @meet/protocol build && pnpm --filter @meet/database build && pnpm --filter @meet/media build && pnpm --filter @meet/memory build && pnpm --filter @meet/jobs build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @meet/api build && pnpm --filter @meet/worker build && pnpm --filter @meet/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @meet/database typecheck && pnpm --filter @meet/media typecheck && pnpm --filter @meet/memory typecheck && pnpm --filter @meet/jobs typecheck && pnpm --filter @meet/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @meet/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @meet/web typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
